content_text:
Civil/Structural Engineer – Inspections & Repair Design
Are you ready to elevate your career while enjoying real flexibility and significant earning potential? Buildfix is on a mission to reinvent structural repair, and we’re seeking an ambitious Civil/Structural Engineer to join our expansion in Melbourne.
If you’re looking for autonomy, uncapped earning potential and a rewarding career solving real structural challenges, this could be your next move.
Why Join Buildfix?
- Work–Life Balance – Flexible working hours to help you balance your personal life and professional success.
- Exceptional Earning Potential – Receive a regular weekly base plus an uncapped share of the revenue from the jobs you win and manage. Your technical expertise, customer relationships and ability to deliver results contribute directly to your earning potential.
- Innovative Repair Solutions – Work with specialist products, repair methods and technology developed within Buildfix, helping customers resolve challenging building problems.
- Growth & Development – Comprehensive training in our products, repair techniques and systems, including interstate opportunities for specialised training.
- Advanced Mobile Software – Our own AI-assisted software brings inspection scheduling, repair detailing and client management together, reducing administration and unnecessary office time.
- Your Work Essentials Covered – Company car, fuel card, iPad with company apps, inspection equipment and phone provided.
About the Role
- Structural Assessments – Inspect mainly residential properties, diagnose structural issues and develop practical, cost-effective, non-invasive repair solutions for everyday Melburnians.
- Build Trust & Manage Customer Relationships – Explain suitable repair methods, their benefits, limitations and costs. Build trust, follow up proposals and turn leads into confirmed work, with the satisfaction of helping customers who value your expertise and appreciate your effort.
- Autonomy & Job Satisfaction – Enjoy the freedom to manage your day and tackle structural problems others struggle to solve. Work alongside Buildfix’s own trades and technicians to see your solutions put into practice, taking pride in the results and the difference you make for customers.
- Become a Key Member of the Team – Join a close-knit team of experienced engineers who share knowledge, support each other and grow together. Your ideas and expertise will help shape our team as we work towards a common goal: changing the way structural repairs are done. You’ll help us lead the way.
You’ll work under the guidance and support of Chris Brown, our National Engineering Manager, who is a structural engineer based in Sydney. Your work will take you across Melbourne, with travel to surrounding areas during busy periods and occasional interstate travel.
What We’re Looking For
- A degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, membership of Engineers Australia and proven structural inspection experience.
- Strong practical knowledge of building construction, structural movement and defects.
- The confidence to explain technical issues simply, design suitable repair solutions and win the customer’s trust.
- A highly driven, self-motivated individual who takes initiative, follows through and enjoys solving problems, providing real help for customers.
- Strong communication and the ability to manage customers, trades and technicians professionally.
- A high-performing individual who understands that greater rewards come from consistent effort, strong results and delivering real value to customers.
- Enthusiasm for learning specialist repair methods and contributing to a business that challenges conventional thinking.
- A current Australian driver’s licence and willingness to travel for assessments and training.
At Buildfix, we reward commitment, skill and outstanding performance. You’ll join a close team with the opportunity to grow your expertise, increase your earnings and see your recommendations become completed repairs.
Ready for your next challenge?
If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with a company that values your effort, offers work you can take pride in and rewards the results you deliver, we’d like to meet you.
Apply with your CV and a short introduction. Tell us about your experience, what drives you and what you’re looking for in your next move. Let’s start a conversation about your future at Buildfix.
